Abha to Jeddah Private Transfer

One private car and driver from Abha or Khamis Mushait down from the Asir highlands to Jeddah city or Jeddah airport, door to door, with the fare agreed before you book.

~690 km by road ~7h 30m driving
Get your quote WhatsApp this route
Quick Answer

A private transfer from Abha to Jeddah is about 690 km by road and roughly 7 to 8 hours of driving. The trip starts with a mountain descent from the Asir highlands, then runs north to Jeddah. Pickup can be in Abha, Khamis Mushait or at Abha airport, and drop-off at any Jeddah address or King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED). The fare is fixed and confirmed on WhatsApp before booking.

Distance
~690 km (approx.)
Driving
~7h 30m (approx.)
Fare
Fixed, confirmed on WhatsApp
Best for
Summer visitors returning home, flights from Jeddah, families from Abha and Khamis Mushait
The journey

Abha to Jeddah, stage by stage

  1. Pickup

    Abha or Khamis Mushait

    Your hotel, holiday rental or home in Abha, in Khamis Mushait about 25 km away, or Abha International Airport (AHB).

  2. The descent

    Leaving the highlands

    The first part of the drive comes down from the Sarawat mountains. Expect bends and, at times, fog or rain, and a sharp rise in temperature on the way down.

  3. Northbound

    The long open section

    Once off the mountains the road is faster and flatter. Rest, meal and prayer stops are taken along this stretch.

  4. Drop-off

    Jeddah

    Any address in Jeddah, or King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED) for a flight.

Distance is the measured road distance and driving time is an estimate. Traffic, weather and stops change the real time, so we plan your pickup with margin and never promise an exact arrival minute.

Abha to Jeddah: private car, flight or bus?

Flights between Abha and Jeddah are short, and for a single traveller with light luggage a flight plus an airport transfer in Jeddah is usually the practical choice. In summer, though, Abha is at its busiest and seats on the day you want are not always available.

A private car suits families going home after a summer stay with more bags than they arrived with, groups who want to travel together, and anyone connecting to an international flight in Jeddah who would rather not depend on a separate domestic leg. You pay for the vehicle, so the cost is shared by everyone in it.

Intercity buses cost less per person but run to their own timetable and stations, and you still need a car at each end. Tell us what you are comparing and we will say which fits your trip.

Pickup points in Asir and drop-off points in Jeddah

Send the exact pickup location. Holiday rentals in the hills around Abha can be hard to find without a location pin.

  • Abha city

    Hotels, apartments and homes across the city centre and the surrounding hills.

  • Khamis Mushait

    About 25 km from Abha. Pickups here are arranged in the same way; name the city in your request.

  • Soudah and the highland resorts

    Pickup from the mountain areas above Abha can be arranged. It adds time before the main descent, so mention it when you book.

  • Abha International Airport (AHB)

    Arrivals pickup with meet & greet if you are flying into Abha and continuing by road.

  • Jeddah city

    Any district, from Al-Balad and Al Hamra to Al Rawdah, Al Salamah and Obhur.

  • King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED)

    Give us the flight time and the pickup in Abha is set back from it with margin.

Who books this route

  • Summer visitors heading home. Families who have spent part of the summer in the cool of Abha and Soudah and are returning to Jeddah with a full car of luggage.
  • Residents of Abha and Khamis Mushait. Trips to Jeddah for international flights, family visits and appointments.
  • Companies and delegations. Teams travelling between Asir and Jeddah can request a written quote by email. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.

One-way, return and summer-season booking

Abha to Jeddah is usually booked one-way at the end of a stay. If you want the same service from Jeddah up to Abha at the start of your trip, ask for both and each direction is quoted and agreed in advance.

Summer is the peak season in Abha, and the days at the end of school holidays are the busiest for trips back to Jeddah. Send your date as early as you can; outside those periods a few days' notice is normally enough. We confirm vehicle availability with the quote.

For an accurate fare we need the pickup location, the Jeddah address or flight time, the number of passengers and the number of large bags.

Planning tips for this route

  • Allow extra time for the mountain section. Fog and rain are common in the highlands, especially in summer afternoons. A morning departure usually gives the clearest descent.
  • Pack for two climates. Abha can be cool when you leave and Jeddah hot and humid when you arrive. Keep a lighter layer in the cabin.
  • If anyone gets car-sick on bends. Tell us before the trip. The driver can take the descent gently and stop when needed.
  • Catching a flight in Jeddah. Share the departure time. We work back from it rather than promising a fixed arrival minute.

Abha to Jeddah: your questions

Can I book a private car from Abha to Jeddah?

Yes. We arrange a private car with a driver from Abha, Khamis Mushait or Abha airport to any address in Jeddah or to Jeddah airport. Send your details on WhatsApp and we reply, usually within 1–2 hours, with one fixed fare.

How far is Abha from Jeddah by road?

Abha to Jeddah is about 690 km by road, roughly 7 to 8 hours of driving. The first part is a mountain descent, so real time depends on weather and stops.

How much is a taxi from Abha to Jeddah?

The fare depends on the vehicle and the date, so we quote each trip. The fare is fixed and agreed on WhatsApp before you book, with no meter and no surge.

Do you pick up from Khamis Mushait?

Yes. Khamis Mushait is about 25 km from Abha and pickups there are arranged in the same way. Give the exact address when you book.

Is an SUV better than a sedan for this route?

For most travellers, yes. The route starts with a long mountain descent and takes most of a day, so the extra space and ride height of an SUV make a difference, especially for families. A sedan is fine for one or two adults with light luggage.

Can the driver take us straight to Jeddah airport?

Yes. King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED) can be the drop-off. Share the flight time and the Abha pickup is planned with margin for the drive and for check-in.

Can we book the trip up to Abha as well?

Yes. The Jeddah to Abha direction can be booked in the same request, each with its own agreed fare.
